psychotherapy.heading: What brings you here?
psychotherapy.introduction: When worry, relationships, or life changes feel difficult, therapy can offer space to understand what you are experiencing.

concerns.title: Worry that is hard to quiet
concerns.description: Feeling tense or unable to settle.

concerns.title: Difficult relationship patterns
concerns.description: The same conflicts or disconnection keep returning.

concerns.title: Being hard on yourself
concerns.description: Self-doubt affects how you see yourself.

concerns.title: Grief and loss
concerns.description: Making sense of life after a loss.

concerns.title: Finding your way through change
concerns.description: A change in your life has left you unsure of what comes next.

concerns.title: The emotional weight of illness
concerns.description: Living with illness has changed how you feel about yourself.

sources.title: NIMH: Psychotherapies
sources.supports: Reasons to seek therapy, daily functioning, and general description of psychotherapy.

psychiatry.heading: Does any of this feel familiar?
psychiatry.introduction: You may know what feels difficult without knowing why. These are some experiences that can bring people to psychiatric care.

concerns.title: Things feel harder to enjoy
concerns.description: You feel low or disconnected from things you once enjoyed.

concerns.title: Worry or panic takes over
concerns.description: Worry or sudden waves of panic interrupt your day.

concerns.title: It's hard to stay on track
concerns.description: You lose focus, forget tasks, or struggle to get started.

concerns.title: You can't get the rest you need
concerns.description: You lie awake or feel worn out during the day.

concerns.title: Your mood and energy feel unpredictable
concerns.description: Changes in mood, energy, or sleep disrupt your routine.

concerns.title: You've tried care, but still feel stuck
concerns.description: You're still having a hard time despite previous treatment.

concerns.title: Thoughts or routines feel hard to stop
concerns.description: Unwanted thoughts or repeated checking take up your day.

concerns.title: Experiences others don't seem to share
concerns.description: Hearing or seeing things others don't can feel confusing.

sources.title: NIMH: My Mental Health: Do I Need Help?
sources.supports: Recognizable changes in mood, interest, concentration, sleep, energy, and daily functioning.

sources.title: American Psychiatric Association: What is Psychiatry?
sources.supports: Psychiatric evaluation and general range of treatments.

sources.title: NIMH: Psychotherapies
sources.supports: Discussing ongoing difficulties and considering other care approaches.

sources.title: NIMH: Bipolar Disorder
sources.supports: Changes in mood, energy, and sleep; concern wording does not establish a diagnosis.

sources.title: NIMH: Panic Disorder: What You Need to Know
sources.supports: Sudden episodes of intense fear or discomfort described in everyday language as waves of panic.

sources.title: NIMH: Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder
sources.supports: Recurring thoughts and repetitive behaviors that interfere with daily life.

sources.title: NIMH: Understanding Psychosis
sources.supports: Hearing or seeing things others do not; these experiences can have multiple causes and require assessment.
